invariants: A component must not become PRODUCTION_PROVEN from a single successful run without repeatable evidence
Deprecated components must not be selected for new composition
Builder compatibility must be explicit and evidence-backed
Security and regression evidence must be current before reuse in a customer project
Known limitations and licensing or ownership constraints must travel with the component
Reusable components do not bypass customer-specific acceptance criteria or QA
Reuse recommendation is advisory and does not authorize BUILDING or Production deployment
Unknown provenance, stale evidence or contradictory certification returns REVIEW or HOLD
Customer-specific secrets, credentials or private data must never be embedded in reusable component templates
